integrity: Analytical spectral and finite-dimensional dissipativity proof; independent position-basis dense rank tests and exact lattice energy enumeration provide finite corroboration only. No claims of independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Two distinguishable noninteracting quantum walkers, homogeneous positive hopping on a binary cube, and all coincidence vertices absorbing at arbitrary strictly positive rates; exact rank but not individual absorption times or arbitrary disordered graphs. General spectral dark-state criteria are known and independent publication priority remains unverified.
title: Rational-speed collision resonances for two quantum walkers on the binary hypercube
